Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.rmi.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerAdapter, VirtualViewRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualViewRmi, ServerAdapter
Client-side RMI endpoint. It plays a double role: as a ServerAdapter it lets the client send requests to the server, and as an exported VirtualViewRmi it is the remote callback the server invokes to push updates and errors back. Incoming calls are forwarded to the registered UpdateHandler.

It also runs a heartbeat: a daemon thread periodically pings the server stub and, if a ping fails or times out, marks the connection dead and notifies the update handler of the disconnection (so the ConnectionManager can attempt to reconnect).
